title: Settlement following social-responsibility and anti-money-laundering findings
summary: The Commission announced a £2 million regulatory settlement following findings on customer protection and money-laundering controls.

title: Mr Green’s share of a three-operator regulatory settlement
summary: The regulator attributed £3.7 million to Mr Green Limited within its three-operator announcement. The £19.2 million group figure is not this operator’s payment.

title: Payment following the Commission’s online-casino investigation
summary: The regulator announced a £3 million payment towards the National Strategy to Reduce Gambling Harms following customer-protection and anti-money-laundering findings.

title: Financial penalty and warning
summary: The Commission announced a £9.4 million fine, an official warning and independent audit requirements for this operator.

title: Financial penalty and warning for the GGpoker operator
summary: The body of the Commission notice sets the financial penalty at £672,829 for social-responsibility and anti-money-laundering failures. It also records a warning.

title: Remote operating licence revoked following review
summary: The Commission reported revoking licence 025718-R-307661-009 following a review. Its notice does not state the review start date.
